title: Meta is expanding its AI agent Muse to small businesses | TechCrunch
summary: The tech giant says the agent can help owners run their business and find new customers. Meta says it will focus on bringing its full technology stack, including Muse, Meta Business Agent, Muse API, Muse Code, and more, to businesses and developers.
